label: Game A
nuance_found: Small real puzzles: carry one gust at a time between outlets, turn the valve so the pipe leads to the mill instead of the wrong pipe, push the bridge sail to open a path, release gusts into grilles and ride the updraft before it fades. Each step has one obvious answer, but the valve and timed updraft made me think a little.
audio: A soft wind drone loop under everything, little chime chords when I caught or released a gust or completed a step, and long stretches with no effects at all while walking.
furthest_progress: Chapter 'Bellhollow': Wake the three windmills 2/3 (Mill of Sails and Mill of Pipes done, valve puzzle solved); on the third, ladders mill, 'Ride the grilles up the ledges', I rode grille ladders1 and ladders2 but did not finish it.
control_trouble: Walking by hand was mostly my coarse control, but the camera zooming into the character's back or face when against rails and getting stuck between planters on the Mill of Sails deck cost me about 60 s. The assist often said unreachable.
best_moment: Catching a gust at Mara's outlet, giving it to the seed wheel and seeing the gate swing open and laundry lift.
worst_moment: Being wedged on a mill deck behind a planter with the camera pressed up against the character, not knowing where to go and the pause menu's safe-spot button not helping.
verdict: It is gorgeous, like a storybook, and the first five minutes taught me the catch-carry-release loop clearly with a big button each time. But it is slow: lots of walking, the same carry-the-gust action repeated, no score, no quick wins, and long quiet stretches. The wins are quiet (a gate opens) not the pop I get from Candy Crush. When I got stuck behind planters with the camera in my face I would have put the phone away. I might come back for the story but I would not play it every day. A 5, maybe a 6 for the looks.
